label: Updated 8 AM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Charles Schwab Challenge
items.text: Russell Henley leads the 2026 Charles Schwab Challenge on Sunday aiming for his sixth PGA Tour win.

items.headline: Eric Cole’s Near Miss
items.text: Eric Cole, aged 37, was in contention to win the 2026 Charles Schwab Classic at Colonial but fell short.

items.headline: LSU NCAA Rally
items.text: LSU erased a 17-shot deficit with an 18-under 270 round on Sunday at La Costa, moving from T-27 to T-12 and just three shots off eighth at the NCAA Championship; Dan Hayes shot 8-under 64 with nine birdies.
